messages:
pagerbot: PAGER: [CRITICAL] auth-proxy detected session-shadowing pattern + spike in 401/200 mix (rule: auth.anomaly.shadowing). Paging @irene-oncall and SREs. https://ops.internal/redwood/alerts/1839991230 :rotating_light:
irene-oncall: I’m on call. joining bridge now — creating incident channel #inc-1839991230. mounting tcpdump on proxy nodes (will paste captures).
samir-eng: looking at logs — a small set of IPs in 44.55.66.0/24 show repeated requests that replay cookies with different user-agents. possible proxy mirroring or compromised upstream. quick grep: `grep "session_id" proxy.log | grep 44.55.66` — confirmed dup session_id with varying src headers.
marta-sre: adding quick ACL to drop requests from 44.55.66.0/24 on edge-proxy-3 and -4. throttling rule applied. see logs: `edge-proxy-3: DROP 44.55.66.128: 12:09:15`
alisa-sec: need containment + evidence preservation. do NOT rotate production keys yet until we archive logs for forensics. we should freeze any config pushes for 15m. also prepare service-token rotation plan if we see token exfil.
irene-oncall: acknowledged. freezing infra flips now (no deploys). collecting logs to s3://inc-1839991230-raw/ — cli-bot, can you snapshot the last 6h proxies?
cli-bot: `snapshot-logs --service auth-proxy --since 6h --out s3://inc-1839991230-raw/` started (job id 01a3). ETA ~4m.
samir-eng: also seeing a small batch of exported debug logs posted to an external bucket at 12:02 UTC — investigating origin. possible misconfigured forwarder. link: https://s3-external.example/possible-leak (restricted).
alisa-sec: if that bucket contains PII, we escalate to legal / privacy. legal, can you standby?
legal: on standby. if PHI/PII exposed, we need customer notification assessment. keep copy of evidence and a timeline.
marta-sre: immediate mitigation: rolled rule to strip `X-Session-Token` from outgoing telemetry forwarders for staging and prod. Applied to telemetry-router-1/2.
irene-oncall: to contain sessions, we're expiring active session tokens for the affected proxy pool. command being run: ```
POST /admin/sessions/expire?pool=proxy-eu&reason=incident-1839991230
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
```
samir-eng: starting key-rotation plan for ephemeral service tokens (per sec guidance). plan: 1) rotate ephemeral tokens (10m) 2) reissue consumer tokens with backoff. alisa-sec — do you want us to proceed?
alisa-sec: proceed with ephemeral token rotation now. keep master KMS and long-term keys until evidence review complete. update on rotation: https://ops.internal/redwood/kms/rotations/1839991230
irene-oncall: customer-impact preliminary: elevated 401s for some EU customers (small percent), some retries surface in logs. no confirmed data exfil or cleartext secrets in public buckets yet. posting status to incident page.
pagerbot: Incident severity set to SEV2 (impacting a subset of customers; active mitigation in progress).
irene-oncall: ETA for containment and initial remediation 30m. next check-in + artifacts: tcpdump + snapshot job id 01a3 + forwarder audit (in 8m). tagging @alisa-sec @legal @samir-eng @marta-sre. :thumbsup:
alisa-sec: after rotation, we’ll run log-scrub job `forensics-scrub --target s3://inc-1839991230-raw/ --keep-evidence` and produce redacted bundle for legal. don’t purge originals until signoff.
legal: confirm receipt. please include timelines and list of potentially affected tenant IDs in the bundle. we’ll triage customer comms after confirm.
irene-oncall: bridging to postmortem owner — @samir-eng will take timeline, @marta-sre will collect operational steps, @alisa-sec will own security summary. closing loop in 30m.
